bio:
Mamalala Palesa joined FinMark Trust as the country coordinator in Lesotho in 2012. Before joining FinMark Trust, Palesa worked as a planning officer at the Ministry of Finance for six years. She held various leadership positions, including director of programmes at the national NGO Secretariat and head of corporate services at the Lesotho Revenue Authority.

Palesa has established strong relationships with the Ministry of Finance, CBL and the UNDP at country-level to implement financial inclusion programmes. She has successfully facilitated the completion of various projects with support from FinMark Trust and other partners, including the MAP Diagnostic, FinScope MSME, Shoprite Money Transfers, FI Strategy 2017-2021, Lesotho Financial Inclusion M&E Framework, and Lesotho's contribution to the SADC Financial Inclusion Monitoring and Evaluation Reports. Palesa holds a masters degree in economics specialising in health planning and financing.
